title: Localizing acoustic and electromagnetic waves in space and time
summary: We study time-dependent acoustic and electromagnetic waves governed by the scalar wave equation or Maxwell's equations in a bounded three-dimensional domain. We establish the existence of time-dependent boundary excitations that can be prescribed on any open subset of the boundary of the domain such that the associated waves are strongly localized in space in the sense that they possess arbitrarily large norms in a given subdomain and on a given time-interval, while remaining arbitrarily small in any other given subdomain for all times.
